name: Sun 'n More
kurzbeschreibung:
**Sun 'n More in Schwaz**

Discover the perfect mix of relaxation and adventure in the heart of **Tirol**! **Schwaz**, a charming town nestled in the **Inntal**, invites you to unwind and explore.

**Sunshine & Leisure**
Soak up the sun in our cozy outdoor loungers or enjoy a refreshing dip in our inviting pool. Whether you're lounging by the water or sipping a cool drink under the shade, every moment is pure relaxation.

**Adventure Awaits**
For thrill-seekers, **Schwaz** is your playground. Hike through the stunning **Zillertal Alps**, bike along scenic trails, or take a scenic gondola ride to breathtaking viewpoints. The possibilities are endless!

**Culinary Delights**
Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** cuisine at our on-site restaurant. Savor mouthwatering dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, hearty **Kaspressknödel**, or a perfectly grilled **Tiroler Gröstl**. Pair your meal with a local craft beer or a glass of fine **Tiroler** wine.

**Family Fun**
Families will love our kid-friendly activities, from mini-golf to treasure hunts. Kids’ clubs and supervised play areas ensure a fun and safe experience for the little ones.

**Wellness & Spa**
Unwind your muscles and rejuvenate at our luxurious spa. Treat yourself to a soothing massage, a relaxing sauna session, or a refreshing swim in our thermal pool.

**Explore Nearby**
**Schwaz** is the perfect base for exploring the region. Visit the historic **Schwazer Bergwerk** (mining museum), stroll through the picturesque old town, or take a day trip to nearby **Innsbruck**, just a short drive away.

**Sun 'n More in Schwaz** – where every day is a perfect blend of sun, relaxation, and adventure!
